releases.notes:
# Blabby World 1.1

## 中文

### 更新内容

- 重做游戏内可视化编辑器：按生物集中管理台词，每句可单独设置触发、阶段、速度和启用状态。
- 双人对话支持“待机”和“攻击”状态；攻击对话不会中断双方战斗。
- 新增 NBT、名称、UUID 精确匹配，以及 AI 提示词导入/导出。
- 恢复可选 DeepSeek 实时台词，并增加请求限制、缓存和失败回退；默认关闭。
- 为僵尸、骷髅、苦力怕、末影人、女巫、掠夺者、猪灵等常见生物补充中英默认台词。

DeepSeek 功能最初由 GitHub 用户 [yiyuyan（commonplace）](https://github.com/yiyuyan) 通过 [PR #1](https://github.com/Ku00115/blabby-world-forge/pull/1) 贡献。1.1 在其实现基础上适配了新对话引擎，并补充请求限制、缓存和失败回退。

### 使用方法

进入世界后，管理员按 `B` 打开编辑器。选择生物并新建“说话”或“对话”，逐句设置触发条件后保存。实时 AI 需在公共配置的 `ai` 部分填写 API Key 并手动启用；不配置时不联网。

## English

### What's New

- Rebuilt the in-game editor with entity-grouped rules and per-line trigger, phase, speed, and enabled controls.
- Added idle and combat dialogue states; combat dialogue no longer pauses the fight.
- Added NBT, name, and UUID matching plus AI prompt import/export.
- Restored optional DeepSeek runtime lines with request limits, caching, and fallback; disabled by default.
- Added localized default lines for popular mobs including zombies, skeletons, creepers, endermen, witches, pillagers, and piglins.

The original DeepSeek integration was contributed by GitHub user [yiyuyan (commonplace)](https://github.com/yiyuyan) in [PR #1](https://github.com/Ku00115/blabby-world-forge/pull/1). Version 1.1 adapts that work to the new dialogue engine and adds request limits, caching, and failure fallback.

### How To Use

As an operator, press `B` in a world. Choose a mob, create Speech or Dialogue, configure each line, and save. Runtime AI requires an API key and manual opt-in under the common config's `ai` section; it never connects when disabled.

Initial public release for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1.

Highlights:
- Visual mob speech and A/B dialogue editor
- Idle, hurt, chase, attack, blocked, and meet triggers
- Day, night, rain, snow, and thunder stages
- Unified text priority and interruption system
- Localized built-in English and Chinese dialogue
- Entity list filters: All, Enabled, Disabled
- Simplified configuration

Requires Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge 47.x.
